parameters.name: AutoConfirmIPList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically enable the latest back-to-origin IP addresses list. Valid values:
- off: Do not automatically enable.
- on: Automatically enable.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation. The plan associated with the site must support the origin protection feature.
